review.content: Keerthan worked on the Community team at KNIME as a junior data scientist, and we relied on his help for a variety of projects. I've lost track of the number of (many!) workflows he built to support our technical processes, many of which were focused on making sure our connections with the KNIME user community remained strong. His work helped us make sure no one reaching out to KNIME fell through the cracks, whether that was collecting feedback from our power users during Community Hacking Days, or monitoring posts on the wider internet. Keerthan was also an excellent resource on our own KNIME forum, providing practical assistance and solutions to those facing difficult technical questions. He always responded with cheerful detail, and I could trust him to independently manage support tickets originating from our community. He also worked to write blog posts (and create associated workflows) highlighting key aspects of KNIME software. In short, I enjoyed working with Keerthan very much, and I'm happy to recommend him.
review.author: Scott Fincher

review.content: I have had the pleasure of working with Keerthan over the past three years. Though quiet and reserved, Keerthan is the kind of teammate who consistently delivers—often behind the scenes—by building, fixing, and improving code with precision and dedication. He has played a key role in the success of the KNIME Forum, contributed to the creation of workflows for a variety of data science use cases, and developed Python code across multiple projects. Beyond his technical proficiency, Keerthan stands out for his reliability and accountability. Once he commits to a project, he sees it through to completion with care and consistency. I highly recommend Keerthan for roles involving data science, development, and workflow building. His dependable nature and technical expertise make him a valuable asset to any team.

review.content: I had the pleasure of working with Keerthan Shetty at KNIME until summer 2024. His ability to quickly incorporate feedback and iterate on work was impressive - we consistently delivered polished content to the KNIME community after just a few rounds of refinement. Together we tackled some exciting projects: developing a Parameter Optimization tool, creating an eXplainable AI booklet for KNIME Press, writing technical blog posts on XAI algorithms such as SHAP, LIME, and PDP & ICE, and building a repository of advanced KNIME techniques with Python integration. He also did excellent work scouting and providing feedback on open source contributions. Keerthan was not only technically capable but also genuinely pleasant to collaborate with. His responsiveness to guidance and collaborative spirit made every project smooth and successful. KNIME is lucky to have him on the team!
